subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy buttermilk pancakes topped with a dollop of honey whipped cream and a fan of brûléed banana slices with a torched amber sugar crust, with caramel sauce running down one side
hero_ko: 토치로 그을린 브륄레 바나나 슬라이스 + 꿀 생크림 + 캐러멜 소스

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The top face of each pancake is griddle-browned in a soft, blotchy, uneven gradient — warm caramel brown (#B9793F) at the centre where it sat longest on the hot pan, fading through toasty golden (#CF9455) into light golden (#D9A76B) toward the rim, with a few slightly darker freckles and one paler patch where a bubble lifted the batter, the way real pancakes never brown evenly. The side wall of every pancake is the pale cream of the risen crumb (#F1DDB0): a soft, spongy band with a fine open crumb texture, tiny irregular air pockets catching the light, meeting the browned top in a soft blurred edge rather than a hard line. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: HONEY WHIPPED CREAM
toppings.text: One generous dollop of lightly whipped cream sweetened with honey — a soft ivory (#FBF1DC) a shade warmer than plain cream — spoon-dropped slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake: soft rounded peaks, gentle folds, a matte velvety surface, its lower edge relaxing into a soft skirt against the warm pancake, with one thin thread of honey (#D9A441) still visible on its surface where it was folded in.

toppings.label: BRÛLÉED BANANA
toppings.text: Six slices of banana about 1 cm thick, cut slightly on the diagonal so they are ovals rather than perfect circles and each a little different in size, fanned in an overlapping arc that leans against the cream and continues onto the browned pancake: each slice was sprinkled with sugar and torched, so its top face carries a thin, glassy amber sugar crust (#C8862A) with darker toffee-brown scorch spots (#7A4218) that are uneven from slice to slice — one nearly fully dark, one barely touched — while the sides and the visible edge of the flesh stay a pale creamy ivory (#F3E7BE) with the small dark seed-dots at the centre. The crust catches a hard, bright highlight; one slice has cracked its crust, and one at the end of the fan has slid slightly out of line.

toppings.label: CARAMEL SAUCE
toppings.text: A warm caramel sauce (#B5651D), glossy and translucent at its thin edges, spooned over the banana and the cream so it pools in the hollows of the fan, coats the lowest slice, and runs over the front edge of the top pancake in three uneven drips of different lengths down the pale side walls — one thick drip reaching the bottom pancake and rounding into a soft bead, the others stopping on the middle layer — turning the crumb it touches a darker, glossy soaked amber.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: A barely-there haze of powdered sugar over the far rim of the top pancake, away from the caramel. A light grating of dark chocolate (#3B2418) — fine, dry curled shavings of different lengths — over the cream and one end of the banana fan. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.
